name: 3S Auto-Raid (GMCP)
author: Joakim
description: 3Scapes auto-raid: dispatch docked longships to a target town (solo or convoy). Fed by the Guild.Fleet + Guild.City GMCP packages (3Scapes only; the MIP-fed original ships as '3S Auto-Raid (classic, MIP)', alias araidc). Same strategy core as the classic: auto-target picks randomly among the calm pool (towns within 2 heat of the lowest), hold rotates towns, keep/reserve protect docked ships, convoy sends one command for the game to crew. The town table lists BOTH target groups - home (lineage, with heat) and foreign (historical, no heat in the feed) - every name clickable, and 'araid pool home|foreign' chooses which group the auto-target raids: home hunts the calm pool, foreign spreads at random with the same hold rotation.
